description: Role rules for request -> scene-layout conformance (docs/ir/scene-layout.md). roles.<role> keys: reach_targets_min (int, minimum reach_targets whose node is this node), require_probe (bool, at least one probe whose node is this node), probe_asset_role (role that a probe's asset must play), require_randomization (bool, node must declare position_jitter_m or yaw_range_deg). joint_state fractions are measured from the joint's lower limit over [lower, upper]. robots.<request robot> maps to the layout robot package_asset and optionally the exact asset_id.
